queries.name: related_incidents
queries.cypher: MATCH (s)-[:AFFECTED_BY]->(i:Incident) WHERE s.id IN $scope AND i.id <> $current WITH i, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS shared OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(f:Fix) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[sim:SIMILAR_TO]-(c:Incident {id: $current}) RETURN i, shared, f.id AS fix_id, count(sim) AS similar_links

queries.name: historical_resolution

queries.name: memory_for_nodes
queries.cypher: MATCH (m:Memory)-[:RELATES_TO]->(n) WHERE n.id IN $ids WITH DISTINCT m OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:RELATES_TO]->(x) RETURN m, collect(DISTINCT x.id) AS node_ids

queries.name: stale_memory
queries.cypher: MATCH (m:Memory)-[:RELATES_TO]->(x) WHERE m.kind IN ['Verified resolution', 'Observation', 'Knowledge conflict'] AND m.validity_status IN ['valid', 'verified'] MATCH (x)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..3]->(s:Service)<-[:DOCUMENTS]-(d:Document) WHERE d.effective_at IS NOT NULL AND d.effective_at > m.valid_from RETURN DISTINCT m.id AS memory_id, s.id AS service_id, d.id AS doc_id, d.effective_at AS changed_at, m.valid_from AS valid_from
